title: CrowdStrike and Dynatrace Disrupt Legacy SIEM and Observability | CrowdStrike
summary: CrowdStrike and Dynatrace join forces to disrupt legacy SIEM, uniting AI-native cybersecurity and observability to speed investigations and cut costs.
body_markdown:
*Strategic partnership unites AI-native cybersecurity and observability to accelerate investigations, reduce data costs, and free customers from legacy platform lock-in*


**AUSTIN, Texas, BOSTON, and Fal.Con Europe 2026, Barcelona – November 2, 2026** –[CrowdStrike](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/) (NASDAQ: CRWD) and[Dynatrace](https://www.dynatrace.com/) (NYSE: DT) today announced a strategic partnership to disrupt legacy SIEM and observability. Available today, three new integrations connect the[CrowdStrike Falcon® platform](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/platform/) with Dynatrace's[AI Observability platform](https://www.dynatrace.com/platform/) and log management capabilities, helping customers accelerate threat investigations, reduce costs, and gain greater control over their data.


Legacy platforms force enterprises to move, duplicate, and pay to analyze logs and other telemetry trapped across disconnected systems. CrowdStrike and Dynatrace are challenging this model with federated search, shared security and operational context, and flexible log and telemetry routing, delivering a faster, more cost-effective alternative without vendor lock-in.


"The archaic SIEM platforms of yesteryear were built to collect data, not stop breaches," said Daniel Bernard, chief business officer at CrowdStrike. "They've turned security into a tax on data. CrowdStrike and Dynatrace are flipping that model on its head. We're bringing together best-in-class AI-native cybersecurity and observability to help customers move faster, spend less, and own their enterprise data destinies."


“As AI-driven enterprises evolve toward more agentic operations, security and observability need to work together, not in silos,” said Steve McMahon, chief customer officer, Dynatrace. “By bringing together Dynatrace’s logs and observability data with CrowdStrike’s industry-leading AI-powered cybersecurity, we’re giving customers the shared context they need to make faster decisions, automate with greater confidence, and accelerate progress toward autonomous operations.”


Three new CrowdStrike and Dynatrace integrations give customers a path to replace legacy SIEM and modernize security and observability today:


-


**Investigate Threats Faster Without Moving Data:** The Falcon platform enables federated search across Dynatrace observability and log telemetry, giving security teams application and infrastructure context without duplicating data or increasing ingestion costs.


-


**Accelerate Incident Response with Unified Visibility:** Dynatrace combines CrowdStrike endpoint security telemetry with log, application, and infrastructure insights to help pinpoint root causes, understand business impact, and accelerate resolution of outages, incidents, and breaches.


-


**Reduce Data Costs and Complexity:**[Bindplane by Dynatrace](https://www.dynatrace.com/hub/detail/dynatrace-bindplane/) enables flexible log and telemetry routing between CrowdStrike and Dynatrace, helping customers reduce unnecessary data movement and maximize existing technology investments.


CrowdStrike and Dynatrace are also deploying each other's technologies across their own environments, putting the partnership into practice to strengthen their own operations.


For more information on CrowdStrike and Dynatrace, visit the Dynatrace Booth (#301) at[Fal.Con Europe](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/events/fal-con/europe/) 2026 in Barcelona.


**About CrowdStrike**
[CrowdStrike](https://www.crowdstrike.com/) (NASDAQ: CRWD), a global cybersecurity leader, has redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced cloud-native platform for protecting critical areas of enterprise risk – endpoints and cloud workloads, identity and data.


Powered by the CrowdStrike Security Cloud and world-class AI, the CrowdStrike Falcon® platform leverages real-time indicators of attack, threat intelligence, evolving adversary tradecraft, and enriched telemetry from across the enterprise to deliver hyper-accurate detections, automated protection and remediation, elite threat hunting, and prioritized observability of vulnerabilities.


Purpose-built in the cloud with a single lightweight-agent architecture, the Falcon platform delivers rapid and scalable deployment, superior protection and performance, reduced complexity, and immediate time-to-value.
